---
title: "Test the installation"
---


Once the installation is complete, you can run Pankegg using:

```bash
pankegg_make_db --version
pankegg_make_db --help
pankegg_app --help
```

(`pankegg_app` is only installed with the full `pankegg` package, not with `pankegg-makedb`.)

If the commands are not in your PATH then use the whole path to the executable. From a copy of the repository you can also run `python pankegg_make_db.py` and `python pankegg_app.py`.

For more detailed instructions on how to use Pankegg, see the [Usage and Tests](#usage-and-tests) section.
